lead_headline: Meta, Roblox and Quora challenge Ofcom's Category 1 decisions
facebook_post:
Meta, Roblox and Quora challenge Ofcom's Category 1 decisions

Category 1 designation adds duties including protections against fraudulent advertising and increased reporting on illegal-content handling. The appeals test how Ofcom has applied those additional duties; they do not suspend the Online Safety Act as a whole.

Meta has appealed Ofcom's Category 1 designation of WhatsApp and Instagram, while Roblox and Quora have filed separate appeals. The challenges concern how Ofcom is applying additional duties under the Online Safety Act.
